name: Lama Sabachthani
overview: The phrase 'Lama Sabachthani,' meaning 'My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?' captures the profound anguish of Jesus at the ninth hour of His crucifixion, as recorded in Matthew 27:46 and Mark 15:34. This cry echoes the opening of Psalm 22:1, linking Jesus' suffering to the prophetic psalm of David, which expresses a deep sense of abandonment yet ultimately points to God's salvation. These verses reveal the depth of Christ's suffering as He bore the weight of sin, highlighting both His humanity in the dying wail and the fulfillment of Scripture in His sacrificial death.
